system.description: While underwater, an Aquata Breather can provide up to 2 hours of breathable air through its mouthpiece. Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi used Aquata Breathers while swimming to Otoh Gunga in Episode I: The Phantom Menace, and Obi-Wan Kenobi used his again when evading Clone Troopers on Utapau in Episode III: Revenge of the Sith.
